added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite gate logs: the single base failure tests/test_a_release_removes_all_worker_scratch.py::test_promotion_removes_worker_tmpdir_and_bare_id_sibling is the defect this node repairs and is absent at head (after-suite-committed.log: 26 passed, EXIT=0), so zero added failures

findings.text: follow-on: the discard release record whitelists keys at _remove_discarded_worktree and omits scratch_removed_paths, so a discarded run that left a timestamp-stem sibling removes it but the durable record names only scratch_path and the summed scratch_bytes, not the sibling removed — the promotion path reports every removed path and size, so the two release surfaces now disagree on what a reader can reconcile, which is the silent-removal class this section closes.
